title: Rabbi Bizna bar Zavda
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Berakhot 55b: “Rabbi Bizna bar Zavda said that Rabbi Akiva said that Rabbi Panda said,” etc. Dikdukei Soferim: “Rabbi Bizna or Bidata said that Rabbi Zeira said that Rav Ukva said that Rabbi Panda said,” which Hyman regards as the primary reading. Yuchasin reads “Rabbi Bita bar Bizna said that Rabbi Ukva said.”
